title: Dicerandrol C Suppresses Proliferation and Induces Apoptosis of HepG2 and Hela Cancer Cells by Inhibiting Wnt/beta-Catenin Signaling Pathway.
authors: Zhou, Dongdong; Chen, Dandan; Wu, Jingwan; Feng, Ting; Liu, Pinghuai; Xu, Jing
one_liner_zh: 研究天然产物Dicerandrol C通过抑制Wnt/β-catenin信号通路影响癌细胞增殖凋亡，仅含少量小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Overwhelming evidence points to an aberrant Wnt/beta-catenin signaling as a critical factor in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and cervical cancer (CC) pathogenesis. Dicerandrol C (DD-9), a dimeric tetrahydroxanthenone isolated from the endophytic fungus Phomopsis asparagi DHS-48 obtained from mangrove plant Rhizophora mangle via chemical epigenetic manipulation of the culture, has demonstrated effective anti-tumor properties, with an obscure action mechanism. The objective of the current study was to explore the efficacy of DD-9 on HepG2 and HeLa cancer cells and its functional mechanism amid the Wnt/beta catenin signaling cascade. Isolation of DD-9 was carried out using various column chromatographic methods, and its structure was elucidated with 1D NMR. The cytotoxicity of DD-9 on HepG2 and HeLa cells was observed with respect to the proliferation, clonality, migration, invasion, apoptosis, cell cycle, and Wnt/beta-catenin signaling cascade. We found that DD-9 treatment significantly reduced tumor cell proliferation in dose- and time-dependent manners in HepG2 and HeLa cells. The subsequent experiments in vitro implied that DD-63 could significantly suppress the tumor clonality, metastases, and induced apoptosis, and that it arrested the cell cycle at the G(0)/G(1) phase of HepG2 and HeLa cells. Dual luciferase assay, Western blot, and immunofluorescence assay showed that DD-9 could dose-dependently attenuate the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling by inhibiting beta-catenin transcriptional activity and abrogating beta-catenin translocated to the nucleus; down-regulating the transcription level of beta-catenin-stimulated Wnt target gene and the expression of related proteins including p-GSK3-beta, beta-catenin, LEF1, Axin1, c-Myc, and CyclinD1; and up-regulating GSK3-beta expression, which indicates that DD-9 stabilized the beta-catenin degradation complex, thereby inducing beta-catenin degradation and inactivation of the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. The possible interaction between DD-9 and beta-catenin and GSK3-beta protein was further confirmed by molecular docking studies. Collectively, DD-9 may suppress proliferation and induce apoptosis of liver and cervical cancer cells, possibly at least in part via GSK3-beta-mediated crosstalk with the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling axis, providing insights into the mechanism for the potency of DD-9 on hepatocellular and cervical cancer.
abstract_zh: 大量证据表明，异常的Wnt/β-catenin信号传导是肝细胞癌（HCC）和宫颈癌（CC）发病机制中的关键因素。Dicerandrol C（DD-9）是一种二聚四氢呫吨酮，通过化学表观遗传操作培养，从红树植物Rhizophora mangle获得的内生真菌Phomopsis asparagi DHS-48中分离得到，已显示出有效的抗肿瘤特性，但其作用机制尚不明确。本研究旨在探讨DD-9对HepG2和HeLa癌细胞的效果及其在Wnt/β-catenin信号级联中的功能机制。采用多种柱色谱方法分离DD-9，并通过1D NMR阐明其结构。观察DD-9对HepG2和HeLa细胞的细胞毒性，涉及增殖、克隆形成、迁移、侵袭、凋亡、细胞周期及Wnt/β-catenin信号级联。我们发现，DD-9处理以剂量和时间依赖方式显著降低HepG2和HeLa细胞的肿瘤细胞增殖。随后的体外实验表明，DD-9能显著抑制肿瘤克隆形成、转移，并诱导凋亡，且将HepG2和HeLa细胞的细胞周期阻滞在G(0)/G(1)期。双荧光素酶报告基因实验、Western blot和免疫荧光实验显示，DD-9能以剂量依赖方式减弱Wnt/β-catenin信号传导，通过抑制β-catenin转录活性并阻止β-catenin转位至细胞核；下调β-catenin刺激的Wnt靶基因的转录水平及相关蛋白（包括p-GSK3-β、β-catenin、LEF1、Axin1、c-Myc和CyclinD1）的表达；并上调GSK3-β表达，这表明DD-9稳定了β-catenin降解复合物，从而诱导β-catenin降解和Wnt/β-catenin通路失活。分子对接研究进一步证实了DD-9与β-catenin和GSK3-β蛋白之间可能的相互作用。总之，DD-9可能通过GSK3-β介导的与Wnt/β-catenin信号轴的交叉对话，抑制肝癌和宫颈癌细胞的增殖并诱导凋亡，这为DD-9对肝细胞癌和宫颈癌效力的机制提供了见解。
